VERDICT: LGTM

The change slots cleanly into the established pattern in `OwnerMapper`. The file already hosts a family of `@Named` `format*`/derive methods for read-only DTO fields (`formatDisplayName`, `formatInitials`, `formatMembershipNumber`, `formatMembershipLevel`, `formatLocality`), and `formatContactPreference` is added in exactly the same shape: a `default` method with the identical null-guard idiom, a matching Javadoc (including the standard `@Named` note), registered via `qualifiedByName` on `toOwnerDto` alongside its siblings. It sits in the natural unit — Owner→Dto derivation logic lives in the mapper — and nothing becomes a catch-all beyond what the interface already is by design.

The email-presence predicate `getEmail() != null && !getEmail().isEmpty()` duplicates the one in `formatMembershipLevel`, but the file consistently inlines such trivial checks rather than extracting helpers (contrast with the genuinely non-trivial logic delegated to `LocalityResolver`/`AddressNormalizer`), so inlining here is the locally idiomatic choice and extraction would be over-engineering. The OpenAPI schema addition mirrors the surrounding read-only fields. No structural changes needed.
